raw_segments.text: Benvolio, here were the servants of your adversary and yours, close fighting air I did approach.
In the instant came the fiery Tybalt with his sword proppared, which, as he breathed
defiance to my ears, he swung about his head and cut the winds, who nothing hurt with all,
While we were interchanging thrusts and blows came more and more, and fought on part and
part till the prince came, who parted either part.
